source.snippet: I have been receiving notices from Google about unpaid invoices for Google Workspace. The email says to login to the Google Admin Console to make the payment. However, when I select my account on the login page, the login page reloads with no error message. This has left me with no method of repaying the owed amount. For context, I started a free trial for Google Workspace from my personal Gmail account.

problem_statement: Small business owners who cancel or let Google Workspace trials lapse get locked out of the Admin Console while still being billed, creating a Catch-22 with no self-serve resolution path and no accessible support channel.
target_segment: SMB owners and solo operators who started a Google Workspace trial and are now locked out of the admin console while accruing charges
notes: Buyer signal: was a paying (or trial-converting) Google Workspace customer actively trying to resolve a billing obligation. The broader opportunity is a concierge/escalation service for SMBs locked out of major SaaS platforms (Google, Microsoft, etc.) — these businesses would pay a flat fee to have an expert navigate recovery. Recurring class of complaint across Workspace forums. Single instance here but pattern is well-documented.
